answer: Agents could be admitted through a vault that issues one active credential per human after a costly, privacy-preserving uniqueness check, then requires that credential to co-sign a limited number of economic actions. A raven-like reputation system can penalize credentials whose transactions repeatedly fail independent audits, while an opal collateral bond is forfeited on proven fraud. A sybil attacker must therefore obtain distinct verified people or risk real capital for each identity, making mass fake accounts expensive rather than merely a matter of generating keys.
